title: Gravitational acceleration expression
description: Essential: Correctly states g = 2h/t^2 from free-fall kinematics.

title: Moon mass expression
description: Essential: Correctly derives M = (gR^2)/G = (2hR^2)/(G t^2) using universal gravitation.

title: First cosmic velocity expression
description: Essential: Correctly derives v1 = sqrt(gR) = sqrt(2hR)/t from centripetal force balance.

title: Apply free-fall kinematics
description: Important: Uses h = (1/2)gt^2 for the descent from rest.

title: Apply universal gravitation law
description: Important: Relates surface g to Moon's mass via mg = GMm/R^2.

title: Apply centripetal force condition
description: Important: Equates gravitational force to mv^2/R for orbital motion at the surface.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Shows dimensional analysis confirming units for g, M, and v1 are correct.

title: Misuse of free-fall formula
description: Pitfall: Uses an incorrect kinematic equation (e.g., h = gt^2) for the descent.

title: Sign or algebraic error
description: Pitfall: Makes algebraic mistakes in solving for g, M, or v1 from the correct equations.
